description: Canonical PostgreSQL 17 definitions for hand-written rules. Update with each reviewed migration; db:check verifies schema, table, kind, validity and full definition. For views and functions, table repeats the name.

required.name: enquiries_closed_has_reason
required.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['DISQUALIFIED'::"EnquiryStatus", 'ARCHIVED'::"EnquiryStatus"])) OR (("closedReason" IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim("closedReason")) > 0))))

required.name: products_tracking_consistent
required.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'SERVICE'::"ProductKind") AND ("trackingMode" = 'NONE'::"ProductTrackingMode") AND ("manufacturerId" IS NULL) AND ("unitOfMeasure" = 'JOB'::"UnitOfMeasure")) OR ((kind = 'HARDWARE'::"ProductKind") AND ("trackingMode" = ANY (ARRAY['SERIALIZED'::"ProductTrackingMode", 'BULK'::"ProductTrackingMode"])) AND ("manufacturerId" IS NOT NULL))))

required.name: packages_one_active_revision
required.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX packages_one_active_revision ON public.packages USING btree ("capacityKw", "systemType") WHERE active

required.name: surveys_decision_recorded
required.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::"SurveyStatus", 'REJECTED'::"SurveyStatus"])) = (("decidedById" IS NOT NULL) AND ("decidedAt" IS NOT NULL))))

required.name: surveys_one_open_per_enquiry
required.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX surveys_one_open_per_enquiry ON public.surveys USING btree ("enquiryId") WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['SCHEDULED'::"SurveyStatus", 'SUBMITTED'::"SurveyStatus"]))

required.name: surveys_rejected_has_reason
required.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'REJECTED'::"SurveyStatus") OR (("decisionReason" IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim("decisionReason")) > 0))))

required.name: surveys_submitted_has_measurements
required.definition: CHECK (((status = 'SCHEDULED'::"SurveyStatus") OR (("roofDirection" IS NOT NULL) AND ("roofTiltDeg" IS NOT NULL) AND ("cableDistanceM" IS NOT NULL) AND ("usableRoofAreaSqm" IS NOT NULL) AND ("submittedAt" IS NOT NULL))))

required.name: surveys_tilt_range
required.definition: CHECK ((("roofTiltDeg" IS NULL) OR (("roofTiltDeg" >= (0)::numeric) AND ("roofTiltDeg" <= (90)::numeric) AND ("roofTiltDeg" <> 'NaN'::numeric))))

required.name: quote_lines_charging_consistent
required.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'COMPONENT'::"QuoteLineKind") AND ("unitPrice" = (0)::numeric) AND ("lineTotal" = (0)::numeric)) OR ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['PACKAGE'::"QuoteLineKind", 'SERVICE'::"QuoteLineKind"])) AND (quantity = (1)::numeric) AND ("unitPrice" = "lineTotal"))))

required.name: quote_lines_product_consistent
required.definition:
CHECK ((((kind = 'PACKAGE'::"QuoteLineKind") AND ("productId" IS NULL) AND ("productSnapshot" IS NULL) AND ("policyStatus" = 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::"QuotePolicyStatus") AND ("warrantyPolicySnapshot" IS NULL)) OR ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['COMPONENT'::"QuoteLineKind", 'SERVICE'::"QuoteLineKind"])) AND ("productId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("productSnapshot" IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof("productSnapshot") = 'object'::text) AND ("productSnapshot" ?& ARRAY['id'::text, 'kind'::text, 'trackingMode'::text]) AND (jsonb_typeof(("productSnapshot" -> 'id'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(("productSnapshot" -> 'kind'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(("productSnapshot" -> 'trackingMode'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (("productSnapshot" ->> 'id'::text) = ("productId")::text) AND (("productSnapshot" ->> 'kind'::text) =
CASE
    WHEN (kind = 'COMPONENT'::"QuoteLineKind") THEN 'HARDWARE'::text
    ELSE 'SERVICE'::text
END) AND ((("policyStatus" = 'CONFIGURED'::"QuotePolicyStatus") AND ("warrantyPolicySnapshot" IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof("warrantyPolicySnapshot") = 'object'::text)) OR (("policyStatus" = 'UNCONFIGURED'::"QuotePolicyStatus") AND ("warrantyPolicySnapshot" IS NULL))))))

required.name: quote_lines_serialized_whole
required.definition: CHECK ((("productSnapshot" IS NULL) OR (("productSnapshot" ->> 'trackingMode'::text) <> 'SERIALIZED'::text) OR (quantity = trunc(quantity))))

required.name: quotes_accepted_evidence
required.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'ACCEPTED'::"QuoteStatus") AND ("acceptedByName" IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(("acceptedByName")::text)) >= 2) AND ("decisionChannel" IS NOT NULL) AND ("decisionReason" IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'ACCEPTED'::"QuoteStatus") AND ("acceptedByName" IS NULL) AND ("decisionChannel" IS NULL) AND ("decisionReference" IS NULL))))

required.name: quotes_decision_evidence
required.definition: CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['ACCEPTED'::"QuoteStatus", 'REJECTED'::"QuoteStatus"])) AND ("decidedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("decidedById" IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::"QuoteStatus", 'SENT'::"QuoteStatus"])) AND ("decidedAt" IS NULL) AND ("decidedById" IS NULL))))

required.name: quotes_prices_reconcile
required.definition: CHECK ((("hardwarePrice" >= (0)::numeric) AND ("installationPrice" >= (0)::numeric) AND ("totalPrice" >= (0)::numeric) AND ("hardwarePrice" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("installationPrice" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("totalPrice" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("totalPrice" = ("hardwarePrice" + "installationPrice"))))

required.name: quotes_rejected_reason
required.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'REJECTED'::"QuoteStatus") AND ("decisionReason" IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim("decisionReason")) >= 3)) OR ((status <> 'REJECTED'::"QuoteStatus") AND ("decisionReason" IS NULL))))

required.name: quotes_revision_source
required.definition: CHECK ((((revision = 1) AND ("supersedesQuoteId" IS NULL) AND ("revisionReason" IS NULL)) OR ((revision > 1) AND ("supersedesQuoteId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("revisionReason" IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim("revisionReason")) >= 3))))

required.name: quotes_sent_evidence
required.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'DRAFT'::"QuoteStatus") AND ("sentAt" IS NULL) AND ("sentById" IS NULL) AND ("sentChannel" IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'DRAFT'::"QuoteStatus") AND ("sentAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("sentById" IS NOT NULL) AND ("sentChannel" IS NOT NULL))))

required.name: quote_lines_one_package_charge
required.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quote_lines_one_package_charge ON public.quote_lines USING btree ("quoteId") WHERE (kind = 'PACKAGE'::"QuoteLineKind")

required.name: quote_lines_one_service_charge
required.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quote_lines_one_service_charge ON public.quote_lines USING btree ("quoteId") WHERE (kind = 'SERVICE'::"QuoteLineKind")

required.name: quote_lines_one_component_product
required.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quote_lines_one_component_product ON public.quote_lines USING btree ("quoteId", "productId") WHERE (kind = 'COMPONENT'::"QuoteLineKind")

required.name: invoice_lines_amounts_valid
required.definition: CHECK (((quantity > (0)::numeric) AND ("unitPrice" >= (0)::numeric) AND (quantity <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("unitPrice" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("lineTotal" = round((quantity * "unitPrice"), 2))))

required.name: invoices_source_matches_kind
required.definition: CHECK (((("sourceType" = 'ORDER'::"InvoiceSourceType") AND (kind = 'SALE'::"InvoiceKind") AND ("orderId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("orderId" = "sourceId")) OR (("sourceType" = 'TICKET'::"InvoiceSourceType") AND (kind = 'REPAIR'::"InvoiceKind") AND ("orderId" IS NULL))))

required.name: invoices_status_matches_paid
required.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'POSTED'::"InvoiceStatus") AND ("paidAmount" = (0)::numeric)) OR ((status = 'PART_PAID'::"InvoiceStatus") AND ("paidAmount" > (0)::numeric) AND ("paidAmount" < total)) OR ((status = 'PAID'::"InvoiceStatus") AND ("paidAmount" = total))))

quotes_preserve_frozen_terms

required.name: stock_document_lines_measured_valid
required.definition: CHECK ((("measuredQuantity" IS NULL) OR (("countedQuantity" IS NOT NULL) AND ("measuredQuantity" >= (0)::numeric) AND ("measuredQuantity" <> 'NaN'::numeric))))

required.name: stock_document_lines_quantity_valid
required.definition: CHECK (((quantity <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ((quantity > (0)::numeric) OR ((quantity = (0)::numeric) AND ("countedQuantity" IS NOT NULL)))))

required.name: stock_document_lines_zero_cost_reason
required.definition: CHECK ((("unitCost" IS NULL) OR ("unitCost" > (0)::numeric) OR ("zeroCostReason" IS NOT NULL)))

required.name: stock_documents_locations_match_kind
required.definition:
CHECK (
CASE kind
    WHEN 'RECEIPT'::"StockDocumentKind" THEN (("fromLocationId" IS NULL) AND ("toLocationId" IS NOT NULL))
    WHEN 'ISSUE'::"StockDocumentKind" THEN (("fromLocationId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("toLocationId" IS NULL))
    WHEN 'TRANSFER'::"StockDocumentKind" THEN (("fromLocationId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("toLocationId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("fromLocationId" <> "toLocationId"))
    WHEN 'ADJUSTMENT'::"StockDocumentKind" THEN (("fromLocationId" IS NULL) AND ("toLocationId" IS NOT NULL))
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END)

required.name: stock_movements_has_location
required.definition: CHECK ((("fromLocationId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("toLocationId" IS NOT NULL)))

stock_document_lines_guard

stock_ledger_refuse_change
required.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stock_ledger_refuse_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'stock ledger table % is append-only', TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';
END;
$function$

required.name: stock_on_hand
required.definition:
SELECT "productId",
    "locationId",
    sum(delta) AS quantity
   FROM ( SELECT stock_movements."productId",
            stock_movements."toLocationId" AS "locationId",
            stock_movements.quantity AS delta
           FROM stock_movements
          WHERE (stock_movements."toLocationId" IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT stock_movements."productId",
            stock_movements."fromLocationId",
            (- stock_movements.quantity)
           FROM stock_movements
          WHERE (stock_movements."fromLocationId" IS NOT NULL)) legs
  GROUP BY "productId", "locationId";

required.name: unit_locations
required.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (um."unitId") um."unitId",
    m."toLocationId" AS "locationId"
   FROM (unit_movements um
     JOIN stock_movements m ON ((m.id = um."movementId")))
  ORDER BY um."unitId", m.sequence DESC;
